subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment.**

The schedule was __capable of bending easily without breaking and able to be easily modified__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flexible**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Flexible **means able to bend easily without breaking and able to be easily modified, which accurately describes the schedule in the given sentence. (बिना टूटे आसानी से मुड़ने में सक्षम और आसानी से संशोधित होने में सक्षम)
 
• This word is an adjective and can be used to describe objects or people that are adaptable or pliable.
 
 
• **Example**: *The gymnast's body was incredibly flexible, allowing her to perform difficult contortions with ease.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adherent **means someone who supports or follows a particular group or idea. (कोई व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष समूह या विचार का समर्थन या अनुसरण करता हो)
 
• **Inadaptable **means unable to adjust or change to new circumstances. (नई परिस्थितियों के साथ तालमेल बिठाने या बदलने में असमर्थ)
 
• **Versatile **means able to adapt or be used in various ways. (विभिन्न तरीकों से अनुकूलित या उपयोग करने में सक्षम)
